headline: Oil prices rise on renewed Middle East supply concerns
why_it_matters: Oil price changes can influence energy producers, transport costs, and broader inflation expectations.
calm_takeaway: This is most relevant for energy exposure and inflation-sensitive sectors, not every holding equally.

headline: Global stocks slip after inflation data comes in above expectations
why_it_matters: Higher inflation can affect interest-rate expectations and put pressure on equity valuations, especially in rate-sensitive areas of the market.
calm_takeaway: This matters broadly, but the strongest effects are usually concentrated in rate-sensitive parts of the market.

headline: Gold gains as investors seek safety amid geopolitical uncertainty
why_it_matters: Gold often reacts to uncertainty and can reflect increased demand for defensive assets.
calm_takeaway: This is more useful as a signal of caution than a reason to panic.

headline: Tech shares rally after major company earnings beat forecasts
why_it_matters: Strong or weak earnings can shift sentiment toward a sector and alter expectations for future growth.
calm_takeaway: This may move one sector more than the market as a whole.

headline: Shipping bottlenecks raise concerns about global trade costs
why_it_matters: Supply disruptions can raise costs for companies and affect margins across multiple sectors.
calm_takeaway: This is worth watching if disruptions persist, but one headline alone may not change the bigger picture.
